description: This PHP source file defines the EmploymentContractService class within the OrangeHRM application. It provides methods for managing employee contract attachments, including retrieving, saving, and deleting contract attachments via dependent services and DAOs.

classes.name: EmploymentContractService
classes.description: Service class for managing employment contract attachments, including retrieval, saving, and deletion functionalities, interacting with the DAO and other services.

methods.name: getEmploymentContractDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmploymentContractDao, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachmentService
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmployeeAttachmentService, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getContractAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves the first contract attachment for a given employee number.

methods.name: getContractAttachmentById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific contract attachment by employee number and attachment ID.

methods.name: saveContractAttachment
methods.description: Saves an EmployeeAttachment object as a contract attachment.
